reviews.t: Good price, no ingredients or instructions in English.
reviews.x: Haven't used them yet so I can't speak to their effectiveness.. but just thought other shoppers should know it comes in Japanese packaging without English ingredients or instructions listed on them (see photos).
Great deal. Actually works. Definitely recommend.

I usually buy different lines but these are great too! Take them for on the go ! And use them before taking pictures ! Just blat and go! My boyfriend love these too lol hope this helps! Thumbs up if it does ! Happy shopping (:

I got this as my first "oil control film". It was fine. After i tried another one though, i realized how much this one sorta sucks. Not a fan. So i use it correct, I dab dab dab on my face, the paper/film thing comes away looking like there is oil on it (i am a moderately oily faced person) and for a little while, it looks like it worked. but after an hour or so, i'm all oily and melty agin. Like i said, i thought this was just how these things worked, but i got antoher one and it was li

Takes all the oil off my face. I have a bad oily face so I have to use this a good 3-4 times a day but its perfect, dosent smear my makeup around at all keeps looking awesome! I love that it comes in a small package to keep in car, purse, or a makeup bag ect.

These are a great value! However, they come in Korean packaging, which is a little odd and annoying for anyone who wants to read more about the product on its packaging, especially since Clean & Clear is made by Johnson & Johnson, which is headquartered in the U.S.  The inside of these packages has a sticky side to help you separate each sheet from the next, which is super helpful. They do a great job at absorbing oil, too.

reviews.t: Terrible! Does not absorb oil like USA version.
reviews.x: Japanese packaging. Not the same as the sheets you buy in store as others have noted. They do not absorb oil well at all. When I use them, I feel like the sheets slip & slide on my face. When I use the USA version, the sheet will actually absorb and stay in place. The price of 3 for $11 should have been a red flag, as the Clean & Clear sheets are $6.99 each at my local store.

I wasn’t sure if these would be like the ones you get in America or a cheap knock off, but they appear to be the same product I’m used to getting from the drug store. What a great value compared to drugstore prices!
Different packaging, different color, very ineffective. Seems like a counterfeit product. Buyer beware!
I ordered them online after I couldn't seem to find any in stores. Love that they came in a 3 pack.
The paper kind just doesn't compare to how well this brand works.

I've used blotting sheets before, and they were usually little pieces of thin paper or wax paper.  The texture of these blotting are unique and something I haven't seen before. It's more like vinyl, similar to a soft plastic bag (if that makes sense?)  They do work well in blotting up oils without overly drying my skin. They won't mess up your foundation as long as you use a dabbing motion (don't rub it). I use about 2 or 3 sheets a day.  I'm rating it a 4/5 because even though it's good, it's n

I reorder these all the time for my daughter I. We've tried other cheaper blotting sheets but they seem to have a powder residue. This brand is free of lint and residue. These are great for anytime use during the day to remove shine and oil.
Doesn't really get much oil out. The Japanese blotting sheets I usually order are much better. I have really oily skin. I used this and was like.... ok, not seeing much oil on the sheets.

reviews.t: Great for touch ups to keep makeup fresh!
reviews.x: These never let me down. I wear makeup daily and I have an oily skin type. These absorb my oil without destroying my makeup. Highly recommended.

reviews.t: Too thin, have to use many
reviews.x: These are very thin. I have to use two whereas the ones I get from the local drugstore are thicker and I only use one.
Does just what it’s supposed to. Convenient packaging. Came in a pack of three. Love these.

I have been looking for multi packs of oil absorbing sheets that I knew would work well for me. I check online from time to time, and finally found this! Just received my value package! Might as well buy lots of something I know I will use! My local store was out. This time when I checked, this seller fulfilled my wish! Haha I am really glad to have my sheets that leave me refreshed.

I mean... I don't hate them, but they are a film and not the paper ones I was used to. I used to slap a paper one on my face and it would stick and absorb oils. These you really have to press and they don't have the same affect. It's ok. I'll use them. They weren't super expensive, just won't buy again

These take me back to my teenage years! Although they will certainly not absorb all of the sweat/oil on your face, they certainly make me feel better short term. I would absolutely recommend for those who need to go from looking sweaty to looking put together without washing your face.

reviews.t: Are these real from Clean & Clear?
reviews.x: All of the box information and instructions are in Chinese. Nothing on the box shows that these are made by Clean & Clear or J&J. If I’m paying $$ for the product shown I’d expect to receive that product. Returning and will buy from local box store.

The product arrived and all the writing was in Chinese. The sheets themselves seemed a little thinner then the ones I am used to but still usable. I would maybe purchase again depending on the price but overall not what I had thought I had ordered.

reviews.t: This version of the brand is ineffective
reviews.x: These are nowhere near as good as the version that you buy in the states. I bought these because it seemed like a good bargain. You do get what you pay for though. I’ll just go to my local grocery store to buy these from now on.

reviews.t: Great price, but they do not seem as absorbent as usa version
reviews.x: These oil sheets made in Japan do not seem like the exact same product to me as the ones I buy from this manufacturer locally.  However, they do absorb skin oil to some degree, and they are less expensive.

reviews.t: I have been addicted to these things for years and ...
reviews.x: I have been addicted to these things for years and always have some on hand. They are indispensable for those of us with extremely oily skin. They will not mess up your makeup and leave nothing behind.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product works well for absorbing oil and controlling shine, often noting it doesn't disturb makeup.
Several reviewers praise the value, especially the multi-pack pricing compared to drugstore prices.
A common complaint is that the packaging is in Japanese/Korean without English ingredients or instructions.
Some reviewers find the sheets ineffective at absorbing oil, with a few suspecting they differ from or are counterfeit versions of the US product.
Reviewers appreciate the small, portable packaging for carrying in a purse, car, or makeup bag.
